channel.title: Terminal Shortcuts Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's New in Terminal Shortcuts 1.3.0

  • Redesigned Welcome Flow: New 4-step setup wizard with clear product intro, permissions, inline license activation, and quick tips.
  • License Activation in Setup: Enter your Gumroad license key directly in the welcome wizard — no need to hunt through Settings.
  • Honest Gatekeeper Guidance: Clear explanation of why macOS asks for approval and how to handle it after updates.
  • Improved Update Experience: Fixed update button not appearing, settings sheet blocking updates, and Sparkle modal conflicts.
  • Better DMG Instructions: Renamed instruction images for clarity — impossible to miss on first install.
  • Free vs Licensed Comparison: Side-by-side tier cards in the setup wizard show exactly what you unlock.
  • Overall Security Hardening: Tighter internal validation.

For more details, visit our GitHub releases page.

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
What's New in Terminal Shortcuts 1.2.1

  • App Visibility Settings: New option to show app in Dock/Menu Bar or Menu Bar only.
  • Command Descriptions: Added a new description field for your commands.
  • Enhanced License Validation: Faster startup with cached verification and background checks.
  • UI Improvements: New dedicated sheets for editing Hotkeys and Schedules.
  • Better Window Management: Improved reliability when opening windows and clicking the Dock icon.
  • Contact Developer: Added contact links in Settings > About.
  • Performance: Removed verbose logging and optimized startup.
  • Bug fixes and stability improvements.

For more details, visit our GitHub releases page.
